parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: The unique identifier used to ensure request idempotence. When creating or updating a resource, if you send multiple requests with the same ClientToken, the system treats them as the same operation, preventing duplicate creation or updates. The ClientToken is generated by the client. Use the same ClientToken for retries.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the API MCP Core service that was successfully created.
